```{python}
#| label: py-setup

from setup import *
```

```{python}
#| label: py-read-data
oystercatcher_py = pd.read_csv("data/CS2-oystercatcher-feeding.csv")
```

```{python}
#| label: py-fit-linear-model
# define the model
model = smf.ols(formula= "feeding ~ C(site)", data = oystercatcher_py)
# fit the model
lm_oystercatcher_py = model.fit()
```

```{python}
#| label: py-fit-the-model
#| eval: true
dgplots(lm_oystercatcher_py)
```

```{python}
#| label: py-read-data-2
state_py = pd.read_csv("data/CS3-statedata.csv")
```

```{python}
#| label: py-fit-linear-model-2
# define the model
model = smf.ols(formula= "population ~ area + murder", data = state_py)
# fit the model
lm_state = model.fit()
```

```{python}
#| label: py-fit-the-model-2
#| eval: true
dgplots(lm_state)
```
